title: Test map
description: Output of the test-engineer role: the tests written for the acceptance criteria of one task, and the criteria that cannot be tested automatically. The verification report and the fail-on-base check read it.

summary.description: What the tests check, in a few sentences.

tests.description: Every test you wrote, one entry per test and criterion. A test that checks two criteria has two entries.

suite.description: Name of the matrix suite that runs the test.

id.description: The test as its suite's JUnit XML will name it: <classname>::<name> of its testcase element, or <name> when the reporter writes no classname.

file.description: File that holds the test, relative to the repo root, with / separators.

files.description: Every file you created or changed, tests, helpers, fixtures and test data alike, relative to the repo root with / separators. The developer may not change them, and the check on the base branch applies them all.

untestable.description: Criteria of the task no automated test can check, each with the reason. Every criterion of the task is in tests or here.

reason.description: Why, and how a human can check it instead.
